title: Session tool-discovery fixture
description: Schema for captured evidence and unverified target specifications under tests/fixtures/session-tool-discovery/. Fixture tool lists remain independent of this repo's manifest source, so compatibility checks can compare 'globally registered' against 'discoverable in a session' without deriving one from the other.

status.description: Whether this fixture records an actually-observed session result ('captured-incident') or is merely a hand-authored specification of a not-yet-verified target state ('target-not-captured'). Consumers must not treat a 'target-not-captured' fixture as proof any real session behaves this way.

globallyRegisteredTools.description: Tool names the plugin manifest registered when a captured incident occurred. This freezes historical registration evidence so later manifest additions do not rewrite the incident claim.

discoveredTools.description: The literal tool names an agent session could actually call via tools/list, as observed/captured for this adapter state. Deliberately a flat string list independent of any manifest-derived type, so drift between registration and discovery is detectable.
